{{Quote|From his throne, Jabba could control everything from the trap door opening leading to the rancor pit below to the lighting and climate control for the entire palace.|[[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]]|<ref name="Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi">''[[Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi]]''</ref>}}
'''Jabba the Hutt's dais''' was a [[Hoversled/Legends|repulsorsled]] that was used by [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] as a formal throne in his [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]]. It was located in the audience chamber, just in front of the trap door to the [[Jabba's rancor/Legends|rancor]] pit.

The dais was decorated with several statues known as "Abyssin ornaments", which were meant to protect the owner of the throne, as [[Abyssin/Legends|Abyssins]] were known for their regenerative abilities. The sled was also equipped at the back with a barbeque, on which [[Jerba/Legends|Jerba]] meat was broiled.

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', the Abyssin gargoyles on the throne were incorrectly depicted as two-eyed creatures, while the Abyssins are in fact cyclopses. In the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Clone Wars'' movie]], on the other hand, they were portrayed right.
